title: Neuro-Relational Programs: Unifying Queries and Neural Computation over Structured Data
abstract: arXiv:2606.11946v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The conventional approach to deep learning over relational databases applies neural models, such as Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), to a graph representation of the database. Recent approaches instead operate on databases directly, associating tuples with embeddings and extending query mechanisms to jointly process embeddings and relational content. Inspired by these developments, we introduce Neuro-Relational Programs (NRPs), a declarative query language for relational databases whose facts carry numeric vector embeddings. NRPs extend Datalog-style rules with operations that combine, aggregate, and transform embeddings, thereby interleaving relational reasoning and learnable neural components within a single formalism. This yields a general approach to neural computation over relational data: an NRP can be read both as a query plan with trainable components and as a neural architecture with relational structure built in.   Natur

translated_title: 神经关系程序：统一结构化数据上的查询与神经计算
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.11946v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：在关系数据库上进行深度学习的传统方法是将神经模型（如图神经网络GNN）应用于数据库的图表示。近期的方法则直接在数据库上进行操作，将元组与嵌入向量相关联，并扩展查询机制以联合处理嵌入和关系内容。受这些发展的启发，我们提出了神经关系程序，这是一种面向关系数据库的声明式查询语言，其事实携带数值向量嵌入。NRPs扩展了Datalog风格的规则，增加了组合、聚合和转换嵌入的操作，从而在单一形式体系中交织了关系推理和可学习的神经组件。这为在关系数据上进行神经计算提供了一种通用方法：一个NRP既可以被解读为带有可训练组件的查询计划，也可以被解读为内置关系结构的神经架构。
tldr: 本文提出神经关系程序（NRPs），一种在关系数据库事实上携带向量嵌入的声明式查询语言，通过扩展Datalog规则实现嵌入的组合、聚合与转换，将关系推理与可学习神经组件统一于同一形式体系中。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Neuro-Relational Programs (NRPs), a declarative query language extending Datalog-style rules with embedding combination, aggregation, and transformation operations, unifying relational reasoning and learnable neural computation in a single formalism.
